arcs.name: The Great Reckoning
arcs.tag: The people who run things broke the law — and the machinery is at last turning on them.

chapters.title: The machinery turns
chapters.html: Declassified Biden–Ukraine documents, 107 nominees confirmed in one vote, and a DOJ done waiting. On 12/18 the FBI walks into a Somali health-services building in Minneapolis and the fraud thread blows open — half of $18B in Medicaid claims flagged as fake.

chapters.title: The widening net
chapters.html: The Epstein files reach Wall Street: Dimon's name surfaces 01/30; Mandelson and Ferguson fall within days. Bondi squares up to charge Mayorkas. 02/13 is the arc's peak day — the Hobbs bribery probe, Epstein forensics, and DOGE's $1T healthcare-fraud estimate land together.

chapters.title: Charges or air
chapters.html: The Fraud Task Force order (03/16) gives the hunt a permanent home; election-integrity orders follow. But the gap between accusation and conviction is now the story itself — the grand jury stays forever 'imminent.'

arcs.forward: Watch whether the named prosecutions convert into convictions as the July window heats the whole chart.

arcs.name: War Footing — Iran & the Mideast
arcs.tag: From posturing to open war in six weeks — the sharpest spike in the whole chronicle.

chapters.title: The ladder
chapters.html: Iran chatter climbs from background hum to drumbeat — regime-change whispers, 'voices from inside Iran,' Hormuz oil-shock maps passed around like weather reports.

chapters.title: Epic Fury
chapters.html: Israel opens the campaign 02/28. March 2 brings the arc's loudest day — retaliation claims, 'Khamenei is dead.' Natanz is hit 03/21; Trump gives Hormuz a 48-hour ultimatum; Israel calls up 400,000 reservists — and then both sides start hunting for the exit.

chapters.title: The crest and the bill
chapters.html: Bridges and rail struck across Iran as ceasefire language firms up; the war ebbs by mid-April. What's left is the bill — oil-shock math feeding straight into the Monetary Reset. The 06/09 strikes after the Apache shootdown over Hormuz prove the ceasefire is a pause, not a peace.

arcs.forward: The seam to watch: Hormuz economics accelerating the gold-reset story.

arcs.name: The Monetary Reset
arcs.tag: The plumbing of the financial system is being rebuilt — on-chain, in real time.

chapters.title: The frame
chapters.html: Bessent says the quiet part: a 'controlled monetary detonation,' a gold reset. The SEC signals a crypto exemption. The chronicle starts reading every Fed move as managed demolition.

chapters.title: Swell
chapters.html: Tokenization goes institutional. Ripple Swell caps a quarter in which the SEC's Atkins talks markets moving on-chain, JPMorgan puts debt on Solana, and on 12/12 the DTCC gets the nod to tokenize $99 trillion. The Japanese-bank XRP thesis becomes a load-bearing thread.

chapters.title: Law catches up
chapters.html: GENIUS and CLARITY scaffolding, the CFTC's friendly turn, BNY and the LSE building settlement rails. On 04/02 the IMF and Treasury surface the risk side — private-credit stress, shadow-banking warnings.

chapters.title: The gates question
chapters.html: Gold and silver repricing talk, Fed pressure, 'gates closing' language. The tokenization facts are solid; whether they add up to a reset is the contest — and July's Jupiter–Pluto opposition sits right on this story's chart.

arcs.forward: The tell: whether on-chain settlement and dollar repricing converge — or stay parallel tracks.

arcs.name: Border & Homeland
arcs.tag: Enforcement, blue-state resistance, and the street — one domestic-control story.

chapters.title: The surge
chapters.html: 'America invaded by foreigners.' The BIA ends bond; Miller hammers migrant welfare. The story's center of gravity moves north — not the Rio Grande but the upper Midwest.

chapters.title: Minneapolis
chapters.html: The Renee Good vigil, the St. Cloud confrontation, a DHS officer ambushed at a traffic stop — seven days that made Minnesota the emotional center of the immigration war. The H-1B Meta memo opens a second front, inside the right.

chapters.title: From the street to the statute
chapters.html: The fight moves to paper: the Dignity Act amnesty brawl, 'demography is destiny,' fentanyl declared a weapon of mass destruction (EO 14367), the Gold Card visa. May brings a second volume bump — policy now, not pavement.

arcs.forward: Whether Minneapolis stays quiet, and whether the H-1B split becomes the right's own fault line.

arcs.name: Great-Power Realignment
arcs.tag: The board is being rearranged — away from the liberal order, toward direct great-power dealing.

chapters.title: Europe unravels
chapters.html: Starmer's Downing Street in open chaos, riots and cancelled Christmas markets, Bulgaria's government falling to the street — 'the tide is turning' becomes the refrain. January is the arc's loudest month.

chapters.title: Openings
chapters.html: Maduro falls and Venezuelans fill the streets; Alberta flirts with separation; Carney talks 'new world order.' Canada — of all places — becomes a crisis case.

chapters.title: Beijing
chapters.html: Trump lands in Beijing with Musk and Huang: a 200-plane Boeing deal, 'declining nation' barbs traded with Xi, and Yermak's corruption arrest pivoting Ukraine from a war story to a graft story.

arcs.forward: Does Beijing mark real realignment or a photo-op? Does Europe's wave break the EU — or break on it?

arcs.name: The Information War
arcs.tag: Who gets to define reality — the courts, the legacy press, the platforms, or the counter-press.

chapters.title: The press retreat
chapters.html: Hegseth locks down the Pentagon press room; Trump fights ABC and NPR; the Biden–Ukraine declassifications land like artillery. Legitimacy itself is the battlefield.

chapters.title: Courts and regulators move
chapters.html: WaPo's CEO out, SCOTUS takes the gerrymander question, the FCC investigates The View — the institutions moving in what reads, from the bookmarks, as lockstep.

chapters.title: Infrastructure war
chapters.html: The Tennessee 9-0 map, Miller's engineered-seats claims, 'Code with Claude' and the SpaceX partnership in the same scroll. The information war stops being about stories and starts being about who owns the pipes.

arcs.forward: Watch the AI/platform strand fuse with redistricting — infrastructure as the whole game.

chapters.title: The health-freedom turn

chapters.title: Soft disclosure

chapters.title: Suppressed science

arcs.forward: Whether RFK's tenure converts claims into policy, migrating stories from fringe into the Reckoning.
